assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The second disjunct compares len(names) against data['live_non_derived_sourceless_count'], but collect() sets that field to len(rows) at run.py:368 over the very list names is drawn from, so the two sides move together and the clause can never fire; only the duplicate-name disjunct is a real check.

graph_writes, llm_calls and spend_usd are literal zeros written into the payload and re-printed at run.py:636, so no assertion or measurement can redden them; a later edit adding a write call would leave the recorded 'graph_writes=0' unchanged.

The bind guard fires when a bind target is absent from the candidates, its unit disagrees, it is STRUCTURE, or it has a live holder with no holder_wrong_reason; reinstating a bind to an inverse-length or STRUCTURE path reddens it, so this assertion is independent of the value it guards.

The retire guard fires when no candidate hit carries a live holder whose name equals the target; pointing a retire target at a non-holder reddens it, and the target is graph-derived rather than supplied by the test, so it is independent.

findings.text: follow-on: validate()'s census guard at run.py:560-564 compares len(names) against data['live_non_derived_sourceless_count'], a value collect() computes as len(rows) at run.py:368 from the same rows list the names are taken from. The two sides move together, so that clause holds whatever the code does and survives the very regression ('sheet rows do not match the live sourceless census') it was added to catch; only the duplicate-name disjunct can fire. The count that would make the check meaningful is the live census size the classifier returned, which is available as census_total.

follow-on: the record's zero-cost evidence - graph_writes=0, llm_calls=0, spend_usd=0 - is emitted from hardcoded literals at run.py:372-374 and re-printed at run.py:636, and audit.log repeats the same literals rather than re-measuring them. A claim that cannot fail is not a measurement, so the 'no graph write' half of the done-when rests on the reader inspecting the source for absence of writes rather than on any receipt; a guard that counts the write calls the driver issues would make the claim falsifiable.
